MTR-001.name: Active creators
MTR-001.definition: Distinct signed-in users or session-scoped anonymous actors that completed at least one meaningful edit during the last seven complete UTC days.
MTR-001.privacy: Anonymous activity is session-scoped and is never joined to an account. This count represents actors, not deduplicated people.

MTR-004.name: Valuable session rate
MTR-004.definition: Creator sessions with a meaningful edit followed by a completed export, share creation, or gallery publication, divided by editor sessions.
MTR-004.privacy: The metric uses aggregate session outcomes and does not expose projects, shares, or individual sessions.

MTR-005.name: Signed-in 30-day return rate
MTR-005.definition: Signed-in creators who returned in a different editor session within 30 days after their first meaningful edit, divided by fully matured activated creators.
MTR-005.privacy: Anonymous retention is unavailable because TrackDraw does not persist an anonymous identifier across visits.

MTR-006.name: Published browser sessions
MTR-006.definition: Distinct browser sessions that viewed a published share or embed during the last seven complete UTC days.
MTR-006.privacy: Temporary links are excluded and browser sessions are not treated as people.

MTR-008.name: Acquisition source mix
MTR-008.definition: Eligible entry sessions grouped into bounded source categories during the last 28 complete UTC days, excluding internal navigation.
MTR-008.privacy: Full URLs, paths, search terms, campaign values, and hostnames are not retained in acquisition events; cells below five sessions are merged.

MTR-009.name: Feature adoption
MTR-009.definition: The share of eligible creator sessions that used each meaningful feature at least once during the last 28 complete UTC days.
MTR-009.privacy: Adoption measures completed feature use, not clicks, panel opens, project content, or individual behavior.

MTR-010.name: Categorized failure rate
MTR-010.definition: Failed terminal attempts grouped by operation and category during the last seven complete UTC days, divided by successful and failed outcomes for the same operation.
MTR-010.privacy: The breakdown contains aggregate attempt counts only and does not expose users, sessions, projects, shares, or individual event records.
